coverage_exempt.reason: Original operator new returning null sets EDI to zero, then unconditionally reads [EDI] at 0x43cabe. Verified original-null-new-probe in work/packets/end_level_gem_closure/cases-check-7.log faults reading address 0 there.

Original table-grow 0x4db6e0 cannot return null: failed realloc zeroes EBP before 0x4dc680 reads [EBP+4], faulting at address 4. Verified original-growth-failure-probe in work/packets/end_level_gem_closure/cases-check-4.log; normal successful growth bypasses this fallback.

The second table-grow uses the same original 0x4db6e0 failure path: failed realloc zeroes EBP before 0x4dc680 reads address 4, so the null-return fallback cannot execute. Original failure verified in work/packets/end_level_gem_closure/cases-check-4.log.

limits: InterlockedDecrement is a scripted stand-in for the Win32 atomic reference decrement.
IsBadReadPtr uses the mapped-memory fixture; Windows structured exception handling is not exercised.
notes: Boundary reviewed against all eight original disassemblies; original game callees remain executable, including object construction, registry lookup, animation and motion.
